C0173.title: CV-Inspector: Towards Automating Detection of Adblock Circumvention
C0173.summary: The 2021 NDSS paper introduces CV-INSPECTOR, which uses differential execution analysis and machine learning to automate adblock circumvention detection. The paper reports 93% accuracy on labeled data and measurement of the top 20,000 sites; the GitHub page documents the crawler, data collection, differential analysis, and labeling workflow.
